docs.text:
Coomaraswamy’s essays on Indian art, music, the dance of Naṭarāja, Hindu and Buddhist thought and the status of Indian women (1918).

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The dance of Siva; fourteen Indian essays · Coomaraswamy, Ananda Kentish, 1877-1947 · 1918, 210 scanned pages. Published 1918; Ananda K. Coomaraswamy died 1947; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
